title: Connect to MySQL — Python, JavaScript & Java
title_es: Conectar a MySQL — Python, JavaScript y Java
description: Runnable MySQL connection examples: mysql-connector-python pool with retry, mysql2 Pool with transactions and keepalive, and HikariCP for Java, plus a docker-compose MySQL 8 instance.
description_es: Ejemplos ejecutables de conexión a MySQL: pool de mysql-connector-python con retry, Pool de mysql2 con transacciones y keepalive, y HikariCP para Java, con MySQL 8 en docker-compose.
